title: 机器学习项目集：Python、深度学习与生成式AI
summary: 该GitHub仓库包含基于Python的机器学习、深度学习、生成式AI和AI自动化项目，涵盖AI代理、LLM应用、NLP、计算机视觉、API及自动化工具，代码清晰、可扩展、文档完善，旨在解决实际业务问题。
summary_en: This GitHub repository features Python-based projects in machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, and AI automation, including AI agents, LLM apps, NLP, computer vision, APIs, and automation tools with clean, scalable, well-documented code for real business challenges.
